Kriselle leads the floral design for each celebration. Choose the support that fits your plans.

Custom floral design

Share your date, venue, and floral budget. The studio prepares a tailored estimate and an inspiration deck to bring the palette and arrangements into focus.

Wedding coordination

Week- to month-of coordination starts at $1,650. For couples who have booked their vendors and want help with the final details and the wedding day.

Full-service planning

Planning starts at $4,500 and includes vendor coordination, rehearsal, and the day-of timeline. The studio tailors its proposal to your event.
